record.question: The committee constituted by the Union government for proper management of water resources in the NE region is:
record.explanation: Answer A: Rajiv Kumar committee. The 4 October 2017 government announcement appoints the Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog to chair the North Eastern water-resources committee. In that period the Vice-Chairman was Rajiv Kumar; the separate dated appointment record is needed and supplied in this row’s companion evidence. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1504851&lang=1&reg=1; https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2018-12/RajicKumarCV.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
